- Licensed location (NMLS): 185 Wythe Ave, Suite A2, Brooklyn, NY 11249. This is the NMLS main office for Go Rascal Inc. (NMLS 2072896) and Adam Styer (NMLS 513013). It is not a Texas branch.
- Adam is licensed to originate in Texas. This website serves Texas mortgage scenarios. For current company details or the secure application, contact Adam at (512) 956-6010 or adamstyer@gorascal.com. Do not imply that Adam personally originates outside Texas.
- Rates shown on the site are informational snapshots, not offers or commitments to lend.
- Loan eligibility depends on credit, income, assets, property, occupancy, loan amount, and program guidelines.
